title: The specification's declared aggregate hash is not reproducible
expected: an external party should be able to recompute the declared aggregate path/hash-list SHA-256
observed: The declared value f12e1060... could not be reproduced under 16 combinations of scope and convention, and it differs from the aggregate recorded in the owner's own inventory for the same correction (402fe23d...). Meanwhile the declared file count (308) and total byte size (37,763,479) match exactly, all ten anchors match, and the owner's own 219-entry target manifest verifies 219 of 219 with zero disagreements.
impact: Not a content discrepancy and therefore not a BLOCKER: every entry was recomputed and every entry matches. It is an unverifiable control value in the specification rather than a defect in the package. As it stands the aggregate cannot serve as an integrity control for an external party.
reproduction: python 20_EVIDENCE/TARGET_VERIFICATION/scripts/compare_manifests.py, plus the 16-convention sweep recorded alongside it
proposed_disposition: Publish the aggregation algorithm, or drop the aggregate in favour of the per-entry manifest, which does verify
